scope: Read-only original Pascal / native Go logic and real-image comparison; then narrow metadata fixes and regression tests. No flash or lock changes.

confirmedDefects.pascal: qnx6.inodemgr.pas CreateInode sets flags/status byte 101 to 1
confirmedDefects.goBefore: newInode cleared the inode but did not initialize byte 101

confirmedDefects.pascal: WriteDirectory rounds inode.size to the block size; FindOrAddDirEntry reuses free slots
confirmedDefects.goBefore: new directory stores 64 bytes; addEntry appends after padded data instead of using free slots
confirmedDefects.stockAndPascal: All allocated directories are multiples of 4096 bytes

validationGap: Old Go fsck verified pointers, allocation, links and names but did not validate the active inode marker or block-aligned directory size. Payload SHA256 alone cannot detect this metadata defect.

fixes.nativeWriter: New inode status=1; block-aligned zero-padded directories; free-slot reuse
fixes.nativeChecker: Reject allocated inodes with zero status and directories not block aligned; Commit, script, batch and patcher publishing use this check
fixes.mkfs: Root and lost+found also use active status and full directory blocks
fixes.maintainedPack: scripts/qnx6_longnames.py independently rejects either defect before any checksum repair

identicalContents: CAP PE stub and pre-tail overlay
RCFS including stock keyboard OS content
containerComparison.freshRecheck: batch.VerifyBuild passed against original input and flashed output; final embedded UFS matches loose UFS

differences.name: CAP tail padding
differences.interpretation: Self-described offsets updated; no demonstrated corruption

differences.name: sparse trailing erased block
differences.interpretation: Go preserves it; Pascal drops it. Not relevant here: complete single runs.

differences.name: V2 leading sparse hole
differences.interpretation: Go preserves absolute logical offset; Pascal subtracts first offset. Actual source offsets all zero.

differences.name: auxiliary hardware fields/hybrid flags validation
differences.interpretation: Generic preservation/verification limitation; source V2-only and all auxiliary fields zero, so not implicated here.

filesystemContentComparison.inputPackages: All stock IMF package files, modes and ownership match the Go output. Ukrainian prototype resources remain staged and inactive.
filesystemContentComparison.opaqueInodes: Existing opaque extended inode metadata preserved; no populated ACL/crypt/checksum fields were found in either compared output.

validation.newRegressions: New inode status, full directory blocks, reuse after deletion, boundary growth, checker/commit rejecting both defects; writer regressions failed before fix
validation.independentOldImageRejection: 143 zero-status allocated inodes, 79 directories not block aligned
validation.review: Independent read-only diff review found no actionable regressions

handset.reported: Keyboard fails on passcode screen after flashing; root/SSH not installed
handset.usb: No supported USB device enumerated during this investigation
handset.causalLinkToKeyboardOrRooting: Plausible but not proven without handset diagnostics/acceptance
